ghāteti.p: [Hana+a+ṇe+ti] (kri) CL=8 Curāditoṇeṇayāsuta ṇeṇayāyogavibhāgaphraṅa့ saka.]  (1) Kill, persecute, and destroy . (2) be grind. Ghāteti(kā,kri) [hana+ṇe+ti] to be killed, be ill-treated.
